_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Nyɛ pʋwaɣa {player_id} kɛ Tic Tac Toe taa.
Paɣa nyɛ kʋʋ kɛ kɔɔla kɛ tɔɔla tɛɛ (paɣa, kɛɛki, ɛzɩ, bee), kɛ tabili taa.
Paɣa kʋʋ tɛɛ, ɛkpaɣa kʋʋ tɔɔla kɛ tɛɛ, ɛtɛɛ kʋʋ tɔɔla kɛ tɛɛ (0-8) ɛzɩ ɛtɛɛ kʋʋ kɛ kɔɔla taa.
Paɣa kɛɛki, '[4]' kʋʋ kɛ kɔɔla taa.
Nyɛ pʋwaɣa {player_id}, ɛkpaɣa kʋʋ '{symbol}', ɛzɩ ɛtɛɛ kʋʋ '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pɩtɩkɛ nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-yɔɔ pɔɖɔma nɛ patɩŋɩɣna yɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} pɩtɩkɛ kɩ-tɛ ɛyʊ. Pɩwɛɛ se pɩwɛ 0 nɛ 8 pɛhɛkʊ taa.
